context_availability.missing_run_definition: Consecutive missing-X roots inside physical support, bounded at physical/date/cadence reset. Occupancy is positions times 5s; first-to-last timestamp span is (positions-1) times 5s. These are absent observations, not physical support gaps.
context_availability.definition: On known admitted evaluation roots, RF61 counts actual supported 5s clock positions. Missing X positions are present in restored context but have zero values/masks. Observed-token fraction divides admitted X positions by supported clock positions; observed/RF also includes padding in its denominator. Unknown Y never resets context.
context_availability.physical_definition: Saved full-publication quote token includes invalid, epoch and >60s gap transitions, even between two individually available origins. Day/cadence reset is counted separately from same-day physical boundary pairs.
context_availability.source_only_definition: A same-day regular pair reset by legacy but not by restored support. This is a known observation/admission-only history reset, not a missing physical quote event.

utilization.filter_input: 141 current base-scaled Micro channels + 32 frozen TCN hidden channels + 4 base joint probabilities + chosen side + 4 causal risk/cost-to-G ratios = 182 channels; own TRAIN-only standardization
utilization.note: Stored rich225 includes causal current/previous London context, fast spectral channels and long STFT. Frozen Micro70 backbone and the V5 filter do not consume the155 extra rich channels. Complete current+previous-day storage is not a learned two-day sequence.

mask_contract: Observation mask is finite(raw feature) AND common feature_available; missing finite geometry/context on unavailable rows must also be masked. Restored histories retain supported missing-X clock positions, never forward-fill. Known target masks only bound scoring/training, not physical history.
